# `scripts/fp/crews/`

[Index](index.md)

## `scripts/fp/crews/crew_bodies.gd`

extends `RefCounted`

The building crews' bodies: HC's trades avatars (roster group "trades"), each under a CharacterRoot scaled to a jittered stature and animated by its gender's clip library with the root motion pulled out, so a clip plays in place and the crew rig moves the worker. start() loads the body scenes on background threads; make() returns null until a scene is in, unless `blocking` (tests, photo shots) makes it wait. Without the roster a worker is a hi-vis capsule.

### Constants

- `WS = preload("res://scripts/fp/world_scale.gd")`
- `AP = preload("res://scripts/fp/asset_paths.gd")`
- `GROUP = "trades"`
- `STAND_IN_COLOR = Color(1.0, 0.52, 0.1)`
- `CRATE_COLOR = Color(0.62, 0.47, 0.3)`
- `CRATE_DEPTH = 0.32`: The crate's depth and height (metres on the skeleton); its width follows the hands.
- `CRATE_HEIGHT = 0.28`

### Properties

- `kinds: Array[Dictionary]`: Trades bodies that exist: {"name", "gender", "rest" (stature, m), "hip" (m), "path"}.

### Inner classes

- `Body`: One worker's body.

### Functions

- `func load_roster() -> bool`: Reads the roster's trades bodies and both clip libraries. False (and why) when they are missing; make() then hands out stand-ins.
- `func start() -> void`: Starts loading every trades body on a background thread.
- `func finish_loads() -> void`: Waits for the loads still in flight (quitting with one running aborts it noisily).
- `func make(k: int, jitter: float, parent: Node3D) -> Body`: A body of kinds[k] (any k, wrapped) under parent, its stature picked by jitter (0..1), or null while its scene still loads. Reuses a released body of the same kind first.
- `func release(b: Body) -> void`: Takes b off the street for a later make() of the same kind.
- `func clear() -> void`: Frees the released bodies (teardown).
- `func stature(g: String, jitter: float) -> float`: Stature (m) for a gender and a 0..1 jitter value, from the roster's height targets.
- `func speed(b: Body, clip: StringName) -> float`: World units per second that b covers playing clip (0 for clips that stand still).
- `static func play(b: Body, clip: StringName, blend: float = 0.25) -> void`: Plays clip on b. Asking for the clip it already plays restarts it (a one-shot that ended).
- `static func playing(b: Body) -> bool`: True while b's current clip still runs (loops always do).
- `func add_crate(b: Body) -> void`: Gives b a crate held in both hands of its carry pose (hidden: the rig shows it while carrying).

## `scripts/fp/crews/crew_card.gd`

extends `Control`

The player's crews on the HUD (feature "crews"), top left under the top bar: how many crews are free, a row per order a crew is on (the crew, the order, the time left, what the crew does now, a progress bar and how far away the site is) and the orders still waiting for a crew. The feature fills it through show_jobs(); nothing here reads the sim.

### Constants

- `S = preload("res://scripts/fp/ui/hud_style.gd")`
- `WIDTH = 300.0`
- `INNER = WIDTH - 23.0`: Text width inside a row: WIDTH less the 10 px side margins and the 3 px stripe.
- `SAFE = 24.0`
- `TOP = 118.0`: Under the compass strip (it ends at y 106 in the 1600x900 base), level with the AI feed.
- `BAR_H = 4.0`
- `MAX_WAITING = 3`: Waiting orders listed by name; the rest are counted.
- `ROW_BG = Color(0.03, 0.04, 0.07, 0.7)`
- `WAIT_BG = Color(0.03, 0.04, 0.07, 0.5)`
- `BAR_BG = Color(1, 1, 1, 0.14)`

### Functions

- `func setup() -> void`
- `func show_jobs(rows: Array[Dictionary], free: int, crews: int) -> void`: rows, the orders a crew is on and then the waiting ones: {"id", "crew" (index, -1 while it waits), "label", "stage" (what the crew does now; "" while it waits), "step" ("3 of 5"), "fraction" (0..1), "left" (time left, or until a crew is free), "where" ("240 m NE")}. free: crews with no order, of crews.
- `func row_count() -> int`: Orders on screen with a crew.
- `func row_text(id: int) -> String`: The text of order id's row ("Crew 1 · Police Station · 2:05 · pouring concrete · …"), "" when no crew is on it.
- `func row_fraction(id: int) -> float`: The progress bar's share of order id's row (0..1), -1 when no crew is on it.
- `func waiting_text() -> String`: The waiting orders' lines ("" when none waits).
- `func free_text() -> String`: "1 of 2 free" or "all busy".

## `scripts/fp/crews/crew_grid.gd`

extends `RefCounted`

The places a crew can stand and walk on one construction site (feature "crews"). A grid of cells CELL apart covers the tile and the scaffold round it. At a cell a worker stands on the ground inside the hoarding or on one of the site's decks (ConstructionKit.deck: the slab as poured, the frame's floors, the scaffold's boards; on a deck narrower than a cell, on its middle line), where the collision boxes that box the deck whole (the slab under it, the frame or the scaffold round it) are not in the way. A node is a cell and a height where a worker fits: clear of every other box and cylinder near the tile (CollisionWorld), of the deck's posts and of the decks over it. Nodes link to their neighbours up to CLIMB higher or lower, and straight across up to HOP - 1 cells of something low enough to climb (a berm, the formwork), by points on top of it. path() is the way between two nodes.

### Constants

- `D = preload("res://scripts/sim/sim_defs.gd")`
- `WS = preload("res://scripts/fp/world_scale.gd")`
- `CELL = 0.04`: HALF cells either side of the tile centre, CELL apart: out to 0.52, past the scaffold's boards round the widest footprint (0.9: out to 0.512). A worker stands on the ground only up to GROUND_HALF cells out (0.44), inside the hoarding at 0.47. Neighbouring cells' worker circles overlap, so no part of a site fits between them.
- `HALF = 13`
- `GROUND_HALF = 11`
- `SIDE = HALF * 2 + 1`
- `RADIUS = 0.35 * WS.M`: A worker's footprint radius and height.
- `HEIGHT = 1.8 * WS.M`
- `CLIMB = 1.0 * WS.M`: A worker steps or climbs this much up or down (1 m: onto a slab, over a berm or the formwork), across at most HOP - 1 cells.
- `HOP = 3`
- `EPS = 0.0005`
- `LEVEL_GAP = 0.002`: Two nodes of one cell are at least this far apart in height.
- `SLACK = 0.002`: A box this much short of a deck's edges still boxes it whole.
- `VIA = 1 << 16`: The key of a link's climb points in _via: n * VIA + o.
- `STEPS = [ Vector2i(1, 0), Vector2i(-1, 0), Vector2i(0, 1), Vector2i(0, -1), Vector2i(1, 1), Vec...`: The eight steps from a cell, straight ones first.

### Properties

- `c: Vector3`: The tile centre at the ground datum.
- `cyls: Array[Vector4]`: Cylinders: (x, z, radius, top).
- `decks: Array[Dictionary]`: CityView.site_decks(): {"rect", "y", "t", "posts"}.
- `shells: Array[Dictionary]`: Per deck: {box index: true} for the boxes that box it whole.
- `cell_boxes: Array[Array]`: Per cell (row by row): indices into boxes, cyls and decks near it, and its nodes.
- `pos: Array[Vector3]`: Per node: the feet, the cell, the deck (-1: the ground) and the nodes it links to.

### Functions

- `func setup(ctx: FpContext, i: int) -> void`: Lays the grid over tile i as drawn now.
- `func near(p: Vector3, dy := INF) -> int`: The node nearest p within two cells and up to dy above or below it (a height nearer p's counts for more); -1 when none.
- `func stands(p: Vector3) -> bool`: True when p is where a node is: a worker fits there.
- `func taken_by(pts: Array[Vector3]) -> Dictionary`: The nodes ({node: true}) a worker at one of pts, at about its height, would bump into: closer than two worker radii across.
- `func tree(s: int, skip: Dictionary = {}) -> PackedInt32Array`: The parents of every node reached from node s (s is its own; -1 for one it does not reach), not through the nodes in skip ({node: true}).
- `func path(a: int, b: int, skip: Dictionary = {}) -> Array[Vector3]`: The way from node a to node b, not through the nodes in skip: the points to walk through after a, ending at b; [] when b is a or a does not reach it.

## `scripts/fp/crews/crew_rig.gd`

extends `Node3D`

One crew at work on its site (feature "crews"): a foreman beside the gate keeping an eye on things, two builders at the spots nearest the middle and a hauler carrying crates from a pile inside the gate to a drop point by the builders, under a board that names the crew, the order, the stage and the time left. What the builders do follows the stage. A crew that takes an order while you play walks in through the gate. Every place and every way comes from the site's CrewGrid (CrewSpots), so nobody stands or walks in the hoarding, a machine or the frame, and a worker climbs onto a slab or over a berm instead of through it; place() runs again when the site is redrawn for a new stage, and a worker whose spot moved walks over when it can.

### Constants

- `WS = preload("res://scripts/fp/world_scale.gd")`
- `S = preload("res://scripts/fp/ui/hud_style.gd")`
- `BODIES = preload("res://scripts/fp/crews/crew_bodies.gd")`
- `SPOTS = preload("res://scripts/fp/crews/crew_spots.gd")`
- `ROLES = ["foreman", "builder", "builder", "hauler"]`: A crew, in order: the foreman takes the gate, the builders the work spots, the hauler the pile.
- `STAGE_CLIPS = { "clearing": [&"push", &"pickup", &"crouch_idle"], "excavation": [&"push", &"crouch_id...`: What the builders do in each stage; a looping clip is held HOLD seconds, a one-shot plays out.
- `BUILD_CLIPS = [&"interact", &"crouch_idle", &"interact", &"push"]`
- `FOREMAN_CLIPS = [&"idle_look", &"fold_arms", &"phone", &"idle_look"]`
- `SORT_CLIPS = [&"crouch_idle", &"pickup", &"idle_look"]`: A hauler with no clear way from the pile to the work sorts the pile instead.
- `HOLD = Vector2(3.0, 6.0)`
- `ONE_SHOT_S = {&"pickup": 0.83, &"interact": 2.0}`: One-shot lengths for a worker whose body has not loaded yet.
- `ARRIVE = 0.1 * WS.M`: A worker is at a waypoint within this distance (world units).
- `STAGGER = 0.8`: Seconds between workers stepping off as a crew arrives.
- `TURN = 5.0`: How quickly a worker turns toward where it goes or what it works on (1/s).
- `BOARD_UP = 3.4 * WS.M`
- `BOARD_COLOR = Color(1.0, 0.84, 0.32)`
- `DUST_COLOR = Color(0.8, 0.74, 0.64, 0.38)`
- `NEAR = WS.VIS_PERSON + 0.5`: The crew, its board and its dust show within this distance of the player (bodies end at VIS_PERSON anyway).
- `PICK_R = 0.4 * WS.M`: The interaction ray has to pass within PICK_R of a worker, up to PICK_H above its feet.
- `PICK_H = 1.8 * WS.M`
- `CHEST = 1.3 * WS.M`
- `TALK_S = 3.5`: How long a worker stops to talk after E.

### Properties

- `spots: Dictionary`: CrewSpots.layout of the site ({} before place()).
- `stage: String`: The site's stage (a SITE_STAGES name), which picks what the builders do.

### Inner classes

- `Worker`: One worker: where it is and what it does. Its body (CrewBodies) appears once it has loaded.

### Functions

- `func setup(bodies: BODIES, job: Dictionary, i: int) -> void`: A crew of ROLES for job (a CitySim.crew_jobs entry) on tile i, its bodies from bodies.
- `func place(ctx: FpContext, arrive: bool) -> void`: Lays the crew out on the site as it is drawn now. With arrive the crew walks in from outside the gate; otherwise a worker walks to its new spot when it can get there, or is put there.
- `func step(dt: float, player_pos: Vector3) -> void`: Moves the crew on by dt seconds; it shows only near player_pos.
- `func set_board(title: String, line: String) -> void`: The board's two lines: the crew and the order, then the stage and the time left.
- `func greet(k: int, at: Vector3) -> bool`: Worker k stops what it is doing to talk to the player at `at` for TALK_S. False while it walks.
- `func pick(origin: Vector3, dir: Vector3, max_dist: float) -> Dictionary`: The worker the ray from origin along dir passes within PICK_R of, nearest first, up to max_dist: {"k" (index in workers), "t" (distance along the ray), "pos" (its chest)}, or {}.
- `func working() -> int`: How many workers are at work on the site with a body (tests and the self test).
- `func release() -> void`: Gives every body back to the pool (before the rig is freed).

## `scripts/fp/crews/crew_spots.gd`

extends `RefCounted`

Where a crew works on a construction site, from the site's CrewGrid: the door just inside the gap ConstructionKit leaves in the hoarding toward the frontage road (a waypoint), the foreman's spot to one side of it and a pile to the other, work spots nearest the middle of the site (a little toward the gate) that the door reaches, a drop point by the first work spot with the hauler's way there and back, and the point outside the gate an arriving crew comes from. route() is the way between two places on the site.

### Constants

- `D = preload("res://scripts/sim/sim_defs.gd")`
- `WS = preload("res://scripts/fp/world_scale.gd")`
- `GRID = preload("res://scripts/fp/crews/crew_grid.gd")`
- `RADIUS = GRID.RADIUS`: A worker's footprint radius and height for the free test outside the site, and the gap kept between two.
- `HEIGHT = GRID.HEIGHT`
- `APART = 1.4 * WS.M`
- `FENCE_SIDES = [ Vector2i(0, -1), Vector2i(1, 0), Vector2i(0, 1), Vector2i(-1, 0) ]`: ConstructionKit._fence's sides; without a frontage road the gate is side (CityView's tile hash) % 4.
- `DOOR_IN = 0.4`: The door, DOOR_IN in from the tile centre on the gate side, and the start outside the gate, GATE_OUT out (the hoarding stands at 0.47).
- `GATE_OUT = 0.56`
- `FOREMAN_SIDE = 0.08`: Across the gate from the door: the foreman to one side, the pile to the other. A drop point is at most DROP_REACH from the work.
- `PILE_SIDE = 0.12`
- `DROP_REACH = 0.2`
- `WORK_LEAN = 0.06`: Work spots are the ones nearest a point WORK_LEAN from the middle toward the gate: of two alike (the scaffold's sides), the one in sight of the road.
- `SAMPLE = 0.6 * WS.M`: Step between the points a straight walk outside the site is tested at.
- `NONE = Vector3(NAN, NAN, NAN)`

### Functions

- `static func found(p: Vector3) -> bool`: True when p is a point (not NONE).
- `static func gate_side(directory: CityDirectory, i: int) -> Vector2i`: The hoarding's open side on tile i as ConstructionKit draws it: toward the lot's frontage road, else side (CityView's tile hash) % 4 of FENCE_SIDES.
- `static func fenced(s: Dictionary) -> bool`: True for sites ConstructionKit hoards in: all but roads, bridges and added storeys.
- `static func entry_side(ctx: FpContext, i: int) -> Vector2i`: The side a crew comes in from on tile i: the gate of a hoarded site (as drawn, else as it will be), else a side with a finished road, else south.
- `static func layout(ctx: FpContext, i: int, n: int) -> Dictionary`: The crew's places on site i as drawn now: {"middle", "door" (a waypoint, shared), "gate" (the foreman's spot), "out", "pile", "drop" (Vector3, NONE when there is no room), "work": Array[Vector3] (up to n spots, nearest the middle first), "haul" / "back" (Array[Vector3], the way from the pile to the drop and back), "side": Vector2i (entry side), "grid": CrewGrid}. A spot the door does not reach (a scaffold board) is only taken when nothing else is left; without a door on the ground (the finished building fills the hoarding) every spot is reached.
- `static func route(lay: Dictionary, a: Vector3, b: Vector3) -> Array[Vector3]`: The way from a to b over lay's site: the points to walk through after a (from the node nearest a, a step up or down at most, when a is off it), ending at b's node; [] when there is none.
- `static func stands(lay: Dictionary, p: Vector3) -> bool`: True when p is one of the places on lay's site where a worker fits.
- `static func fits(col: CollisionWorld, p: Vector3) -> bool`: True when a person can stand at p (x, z) on the walkable ground (CollisionWorld).
- `static func line_clear(col: CollisionWorld, a: Vector3, b: Vector3) -> bool`: True when a person walks from a to b in a straight line on the ground without running into anything.

## `scripts/fp/crews/crews_feature.gd`

extends `FpFeature`

The player's building crews (integration feature "crews"). Every order placed from the phone (CitySim.apply_player_order) goes to one of D.CREWS crews, which builds it in real time: two to five minutes for a building at game speed 1, while later orders wait for a free crew. The crew is on site to see (CrewRig): a foreman by the gate, builders at work in the middle, a hauler carrying crates, dust while they work and a board over the gate with the crew, the order, the stage and the time left. A crew that takes an order while you play walks in through the gate, and a road crew moves along the road as the work goes on. The crew card under the top bar lists the orders with their stage, progress and countdown, and the ones still waiting. E on a worker gets a word about the job; a toast says when an order is done.

### Constants

- `D = preload("res://scripts/sim/sim_defs.gd")`
- `WS = preload("res://scripts/fp/world_scale.gd")`
- `S = preload("res://scripts/fp/ui/hud_style.gd")`
- `BODIES = preload("res://scripts/fp/crews/crew_bodies.gd")`
- `SPOTS = preload("res://scripts/fp/crews/crew_spots.gd")`
- `RIG = preload("res://scripts/fp/crews/crew_rig.gd")`
- `CARD = preload("res://scripts/fp/crews/crew_card.gd")`
- `REFRESH = 0.25`
- `PLACE_WAIT = 6.0`: A crew that takes an order waits this long for its site to be drawn before it is placed anyway (on foot CityView holds a rebuild in front of the camera back for up to 5 s).
- `HERE = 0.75`: Within this distance the card reads "here" instead of a distance.
- `DIRS = ["N", "NE", "E", "SE", "S", "SW", "W", "NW"]`
- `OCCLUDE = 0.3 * WS.M`: Anything the interaction ray meets this much before a worker hides the worker.
- `SAYINGS = { "foreman": [ "We're {stage} on the {label}. Ready in {left}.", "Right on schedule: th...`: What a worker says on E: {stage}, {Stage} (capitalised), {label}, {left}.
- `PHOTO_BACK = 0.62`: The photo shot: the camera stands on the sidewalk this far out from the middle of a lot whose hoarding gate faces a road and looks in through the gate, at an order PHOTO_DONE of the way.
- `PHOTO_DONE = 0.5`
- `PHOTO_BUILDINGS = ["police", "fire_station", "school", "park"]`

### Properties

- `rigs: Dictionary`: Order id -> CrewRig, for every order a crew is on.

### Functions

- `func feature_id() -> String`
- `func setup(p_ctx: FpContext) -> void`
- `func on_world_rebuilt() -> void`: Boot, load or New City: the crews of the city as it is now, already at work.
- `func teardown() -> void`
- `func to_dict() -> Dictionary`
- `func from_dict(d: Dictionary) -> void`
- `func self_test() -> Dictionary`
- `func pick(origin: Vector3, dir: Vector3, max_dist: float) -> Dictionary`: The worker nearest along the ray that nothing hides: {"kind": "crew", "id": "<order>:<k>", "tile", "pos" (its chest), "dist", "label", "data": {"job", "worker", "role"}}, or {}.
- `func photo_shots() -> Array`: One shot through the gate of a site a crew works on ("crews"); photo_prepare places the order.
- `func photo_prepare() -> void`: Photo tour: a phone order on the shot's lot, PHOTO_DONE of the way, its site drawn and its crew already at their places.
- `func photo_restore() -> void`
